notablePrerequisites:
Born to Drive and Presence of Gond attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
